Nature.title: A ‘super’ El Niño could transform the Amazon. Is the world’s biggest rainforest doomed?
Nature.summary:
Nature, Published online: 11 August 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02449-w

The Amazon rainforest might be closer to a tipping point than scientists thought. Some fear that droughts and fire could nudge it into irreversible decline.
